from shop.api.app import App
from shop.service.cart_service import CartService
from shop.service.catalog_service import CatalogService
from shop.store.cart_store import CartStore
from shop.store.product_store import ProductStore
from shop.store.coupon_store import CouponStore


def build_app():
    cart_store = CartStore()
    product_store = ProductStore()
    coupon_store = CouponStore()
    cart_service = CartService(cart_store, product_store, coupon_store)
    catalog_service = CatalogService(product_store)
    return App(cart_service, catalog_service)
